headline: OJK Issues New Guidelines, Urges Banks to Finance Green Buildings
summary: The Financial Services Authority (OJK) issued new guidance encouraging banks to expand financing for green buildings through sustainability-linked loans.
why: The OJK regulates Indonesia's banks and financial institutions, so its guidance shapes lending priorities and sustainable finance in the country.
original_headline: OJK Terbitkan Panduan Baru, Ajak Bank Biayai Gedung Hijau
